task: Compose the prioritree-cli route — the decomposition proposal (stages, units, gates, the pipeline), authored in-message for the collaborator's validation before any route op records it
prompt:
COMPOSE THE PRIORITREE-CLI ROUTE — the effort's decomposition proposal, authored IN-MESSAGE for the collaborator's validation BEFORE any route op records it (the birth store's precedent: the composition validated by the collaborator, then the recording).

THE STORE (born this turn): .plans/ideation/2026-11-20-prioritree-cli/ — the heart minted (schema 0.2, the empty route, the members roster: route_author keikaku, build jikko, verify kensho, assess hyoka, dispatch shinko; status composed).

THE GROUND TO READ (the tree is the truth; operation budget: at most 10 reads):
- The two stores' routes (the composition precedents): .plans/ideation/2026-11-19-prioritree-birth/.junro/junro.json (the birth store's form — stages with purposes + entry_conditions, increments with owners/gates/steps, the gates' ruled conditions) and .plans/ideation/2026-11-20-prioritree-core/.junro/junro.json (the six-unit pattern — the pipeline stage per unit, the brief gate + build gate per unit, the precedence law).
- CONTINUATION.md (the close's record: the core DONE, the staged candidates, the CLI ruled in).
- src/prioritree/session.py (the five-op public surface the CLI wraps — Session, register_run, next_pair, cast_vote, read_vote_state, tally_rank; the refusals; ExhaustedQueue) and pyproject.toml (the floor: zero runtime deps — argparse stdlib, never typer/click; pyright strict 0/0/0; ruff ALL zero findings).

THE COMPOSITION (the proposal whole, in-message): the stage(s), the increments (units), the gates (each unit's brief gate + build gate), the entry conditions, the per-unit pipeline law (discover → understand → synthesize before build — the precedence held at every prior unit).

THE COMPOSITION QUESTIONS TO NAME — each with a [PROPOSED] default + its one-line reason (the collaborator rules at the validation): (1) the CLI's shape — subcommands (register/next/vote/tally...) vs an interactive session vs both; (2) THE PERSISTENCE QUESTION (the load-bearing one) — the core is in-memory per Session; a CLI process exits between invocations: does the run state persist (a file-backed store — NEW wrapper-tier surface, the birth ruling 'pure logic at birth, no DB' priced honestly) or does the CLI run one whole session per invocation (in-memory, exit — the zero-persistence form)?; (3) the unit granularity — one CLI unit or several (the commands, the interactive loop, the persistence — each its own unit or one whole?); (4) the CLI's acceptance bar (an end-to-end verification unit? the wrapper exercised whole?); (5) the I/O forms (stdin/stdout, the report shapes, exit codes).

THE FORM: the composition returned IN-MESSAGE (one transit, no file writes — the recording via the route ops follows the collaborator's validation; your junro grant is the composition lane). No route ops this turn — the validation gates the recording.

task: The run-store unit's discovery census — what exists (the door's public surface, the state that must cross the exit), the gaps the brief must pin, the laws riding
prompt: DISCOVER THE RUN-STORE UNIT — the first unit of the prioritree-cli route (the CLI's persistence seam). Read-only census; no writes; fail-fast if ground is missing. The unit: the wrapper-tier file-backed run store per Q-cli-persistence's ruling (a flat JSON store; the core stays in-memory, zero-dep, untouched — the tier owns its store; the subcommand shape demands state across process exits). READ (the tree is the truth; operation budget: at most 8 reads): src/prioritree/session.py (the five-op public door whole — the signatures, the refusals, the state behind them); src/prioritree/registry.py (RunManifest's fields — the reconstruction inputs: items, operator, quorum, registered_at; register_run's minting); src/prioritree/votes.py (VoteRecord's fields, the dedup key's members, the revote/supersede semantics — the replay's laws); pyproject.toml (the floor: zero runtime deps — json/argparse stdlib); .plans/state/friction-ledger.jsonl (the in-tree append-only JSONL precedent — the store's sibling form; a bounded read, the head only); .plans/ideation/2026-11-20-prioritree-cli/plan/keikaku-composition.md (the unit's scope fence + the gate's conditions). DELIVER (in-message, ~60-80 lines): (1) THE CENSUS — what exists: the door's exact public surface, the state that must cross the process exit, the reconstruction inputs the public types carry (the manifest's fields, the vote record's fields), the in-tree precedents; (2) THE GAPS the brief must pin: the store's home path, the file format, the run-id stability across the round-trip, the clock-stamp divergence's honesty pin, the write path (save-at-cast vs save-at-exit), the corrupt-file refusal, the atomicity window; (3) THE LAWS RIDING: the fence (no persistence verb added to the five-op door), zero runtime deps, the naming law, content-in-configuration, the no-shell law. No writes — the census returns in-message; shinko lands it at discover/run-store.md.

task: The run-store unit's mechanism analysis — the reconstruction chain, the clock-stamp divergence, the write path, the refusal paths, the fence
prompt: UNDERSTAND THE RUN-STORE UNIT'S MECHANISMS — the persistence seam's chains underneath the claims. Read-only analysis; no writes; fail-fast if ground is missing. THE QUESTIONS: (1) THE RECONSTRUCTION CHAIN — what must cross the process exit and what rebuilds it: the manifest's frozen fields (items, operator, quorum — the re-register inputs), the vote log's replay (re-cast in order: the dedup key's members, the vote-id minting's sequential stability, the census's clock-free byte-identity), the run-id minting's stability across a fresh registry (RUN-{####} — the round-trip's id question); (2) THE CLOCK-STAMP DIVERGENCE — recorded_at/registered_at re-stamp at replay: the honesty pin's form (the equality surface field-selected, the acceptance unit's own precedent at src/prioritree/acceptance.py); (3) THE WRITE PATH — save-at-cast vs save-at-exit: the append's atomicity window, the crash-between-casts state, the truncated-log load; (4) THE CORRUPT-FILE REFUSAL PATHS — the JSON parse failure, the schema-violating record, the orphaned supersedes reference: the expected/found/next-action form; (5) THE FENCE — the store composes the public door ONLY (register_run + cast_vote at the replay): confirm the reconstruction needs no core internals (the private stores stay private). READ: src/prioritree/session.py, src/prioritree/registry.py, src/prioritree/votes.py (the mechanisms whole), src/prioritree/acceptance.py (the clock-free surface precedent). Operation budget: at most 8 reads. DELIVER (in-message, ~60-80 lines): the mechanism analysis — each chain named, the reconstruction's fidelity surface pinned (what IS identical across the round-trip, what re-stamps), the write path's ruling questions for the brief, the refusal paths. No writes — shinko lands it at understand/run-store.md.

task: Synthesize the run-store unit's build brief — the exact-task spec over the two legs, at G-RUN-STORE-BRIEF
prompt: SYNTHESIZE THE RUN-STORE UNIT'S BUILD BRIEF — the exact-task spec at G-RUN-STORE-BRIEF (the gated increment; the collaborator rules at the approval). THE LEGS (read from disk FIRST — the join's ground): .plans/ideation/2026-11-20-prioritree-cli/discover/run-store.md (tansa's census: the door's public surface, the reconstruction inputs, the eight gaps, the laws) + .plans/ideation/2026-11-20-prioritree-cli/understand/run-store.md (rikai's mechanisms: the reconstruction chain, the field-selected fidelity surface, the write-path trade, the refusal paths, the fence's confirmation). THE CONVERGENCE: no divergence survives the join (amendment 25's form); any divergence named and resolved in the brief's own per the accepted-cost clause. THE RULINGS BINDING: Q-cli-persistence (file-backed, the flat store, the tier owns it; the core untouched — no persistence verb on the five-op door); Q-cli-granularity (this unit alone: the persistence seam — the command face is the NEXT unit, nothing of it here); the gate G-RUN-STORE's four conditions (read them at the route's gates record). THE BRIEF MUST CARRY (each [PROPOSED] default + a one-line reason — the collaborator rules at the gate): (1) the module + the public surface (the naming law: a new symbol's name = the first word of its act-statement — e.g. the act "Persist the run state across invocations" prices the names); (2) the store's home path (a named constant, content-in-configuration); (3) the file format (the manifest block + the vote log — the JSONL append form vs the single JSON doc; the type-exact serialization of Pair/frozenset/tuple); (4) the write path (save-at-cast vs save-at-exit — rikai's trade: the crash window bounded); (5) THE ROUND-TRIP PROPERTY'S EQUALITY SURFACE (the field-selected form: the census MAPS, the vote ids under the single-run in-order replay, the TallyResult — byte-identical; the stamps named and excluded — the acceptance unit's own honesty pin); (6) the corrupt-file refusal (the store's pre-pass, the three-field grammar, the trigger set, the refusal type's name); (7) the run-id/vote-id stability ruling (the file's name as the run's cross-process identity); (8) the tests (the named edges: the round-trip, the corrupt file, the crash-tail, the supersede replay); (9) the floor (pyright 0/0/0, ruff zero findings, zero ignores — a new ignore is a ruling HERE at the brief, never at the build; zero runtime deps — json stdlib); (10) the carriers table (the gate's four conditions → the spec's carriers). RETURN the brief in-message (~80-100 lines, the acceptance-brief form: §0 ground, §1 the module, §2 the store's mechanics, §3 the round-trip property, §4 the refusal paths, §5 the tests + the floor, the carriers table, the open questions carried to the gate); shinko lands it at synthesize/run-store-brief.md and the gate awaits the collaborator's approval.

task: Author the run-store unit's exact file contents — two single-goal acts: run_store.py (one fenced block), then test_run_store.py (one fenced block)
prompt: AUTHOR THE RUN-STORE UNIT'S EXACT FILE CONTENTS — the fenced-bytes addendum per amendments 14-15 (G-RUN-STORE-BRIEF green; the approved brief at synthesize/run-store-brief.md IS the law — the four open questions ruled wholesale: the class Persist; the home .prioritree/runs; the door's verbatim in-file run_id; single-writer by contract). TWO single-goal authoring acts, one per file: (1) the complete content of src/prioritree/run_store.py — one fenced block (the module docstring; the imports; STORE_HOME the named constant; StoreRefusedError the three-field family member; the Persist class — the register/load factories composing fresh Registry() + Session(registry), the cast/serve/census/rank verbs delegating through the door, the run_id property the file's stem; the save-at-cast write path — the manifest line at register_run's return, the vote line at cast_vote's return, one complete line + newline per append, flush; the ack rule — acknowledged=True appends NOTHING; the failed append's loud refusal; the load's whole-file pre-pass — parse + validate BEFORE any re-cast, the six trigger classes each in the three-field grammar naming the line number, the missing file's refusal rendering the home's live set; the id ruling — the file-name mint scans the store home (max RUN-{n} + 1), the vote ids and the in-file run_id the door's verbatim; single-writer documented); (2) the complete content of tests/test_run_store.py — one fenced block (the six named edges per the brief §5: the round-trip over the field-selected surface with the stamps asserted EXCLUDED; the corrupt file each trigger refused with the container never constructed; the crash-tail — the truncated last line refused, the clean file minus its tail loading whole with .serve re-serving; the supersede replay; the empty-run load a value never a refusal; the double-write absorption — every test on tmp paths, never the real STORE_HOME). The floor as authored code: pyright-strict 0/0/0 zero in-code ignores, ruff-ALL zero findings (line-length 120; the tests ruling S101/PLR2004 stands), zero runtime deps (json + pathlib stdlib), five-field docstrings on every public symbol (Purpose/Refuses when/Re-run/Touches/Provenance — Provenance citing the approved brief's sections, Q-cli-persistence, G-RUN-STORE). Return each in its own single-goal message; shinko lands the record at synthesize/run-store-bytes.md.
